source_title: Trump: US-Iran meeting at UN was ‘very good’

label: posed for a selfie at UN assembly
detail: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese posed for a selfie with US President Donald Trump at the UN assembly in New York, posting the image to Instagram with the caption 'Always good to catch up with @potus'.
source_title: Australia news live: Joyce says One Nation talking to Coalition about power-sharing agreement; fog causes Sydney airport delays

label: allowed extradition case against pro-Palestine activist to proceed in courts
detail: Spain's government decided to allow the Trump administration's extradition request against US citizen James 'Fergie' Chambers to continue in Spanish courts, remanding it to the justice system rather than rejecting it outright. Chambers, imprisoned in Madrid, is accused of allegedly supporting Hamas through donations to Palestinians.
source_title: Spain allows US extradition case against pro-Palestine aid donor to proceed

label: disclosed that Iranian officials held talks with US special envoy on sidelines of UN general assembly
detail: Donald Trump disclosed that Iranian officials, including foreign minister Abbas Araghchi, held three hours of talks with US special envoy Steve Witkoff on the sidelines of the UN general assembly in New York, with further meetings planned in the near future.
source_title: Iran and US have held talks on sidelines of UN summit, says Donald Trump

label: California and New York sued the Trump administration over plans to buy back offshore wind leases
detail: Democratic attorneys general from California and New York sued the Trump administration over its plans to buy back offshore wind leases and halt wind energy projects. California attorney general Rob Bonta sued over removal of a project off California's coast, while New York attorney general Letitia James led seven states in suits seeking to block wind energy deals worth $1.4 billion in taxpayer buybacks.
source_title: California and New York sue over Trump push to halt wind energy projects

label: said Ukraine is ready for an energy ceasefire if Russia halts attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure
detail: On the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky told journalists that Kyiv is ready to halt strikes on Russian energy infrastructure if Moscow agrees to do the same, expressing hope that the American side will help bring Russia to negotiations.
source_title: Zelensky says Ukraine is ready for an energy ceasefire with Russia

label: condemned Russian electoral interference and information warfare
detail: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham addressed the UN General Assembly, accusing Russia of information warfare and attempting to interfere in the 2019 election. He announced a National Centre for Information Defence to counter hostile state information attacks.
source_title: UK PM Burnham condemns ‘repulsive’ Russian electoral interference

label: announced aviation sanctions shutting down all Iranian airlines effective September 23
detail: The US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that all Iranian airlines would be shut down on September 23 through secondary sanctions on aviation service providers, threatening to cut off foreign firms from the dollar system if they provide fuel, landing services, or sell tickets to Iranian carriers.
source_title: Iran flights to Baghdad, Muscat cancelled ahead of US aviation sanctions

label: held three-hour talks on the sidelines of UNGA despite tensions
detail: US and Iranian officials met for three hours on the sidelines of the 81st UN General Assembly, occurring despite US President Donald Trump's threat to 'annihilate' Iran.
source_title: UNGA Day 1: US and Iran hold talks despite Trump’s threat

label: referred slavery reparations petition to privy council
detail: King Charles referred Jamaica's slavery reparations petition to the UK's Judicial Committee of the Privy Council for legal advice, after Jamaica's culture minister Olivia Grange lodged the petition on September 7, 2026. The petition seeks guidance on whether the forced transport of Africans to Jamaica was lawful, whether it constituted a crime against humanity, and whether Britain is obligated to provide restitution.
source_title: Jamaica hails King’s decision to refer slavery reparations petition to privy council as ‘really big deal’
